svg.title: Tarang Gupta
svg.desc: Tarang Gupta. Computer Science undergraduate at VIT Chennai, 2024 to 2028. I build backend-heavy web systems, and I write down where they stop working. Chennai. Open to internships and freelance work. Diagram: in ShopOS, a database query scoped by organizationId passes the tenant guard; an unscoped query throws TenantScopeError before it reaches MongoDB.
